scripts.dev:api: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @cherrylink/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @cherrylink/web
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @cherrylink/worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/server apps/api apps/worker apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @cherrylink/web && npm run build -w @cherrylink/api && npm run build -w @cherrylink/worker
scripts.admin:create: npm run build:libs && node --import tsx scripts/create-admin.ts
scripts.mysql:check: npm run build:libs && node --import tsx scripts/mysql-check.ts
